title: 第9章 白丸

第9章 白丸
月上柳梢。
李尺泾骤然睁眼，望着坐在一旁捧着记录《接引法》的布帛喝着茶的李木田。
“父亲，这两月法诀我已烂熟于心。”他顿了顿道：“今日是八节之立夏，或可一试。”
“去试吧。”
李木田点点头，缓声道。
李尺泾大喜过望，三个哥哥也满心期盼，帮忙着焚香沐浴，立了案台在院里。
再由李木田恭恭敬敬地请出法鉴，用前些日子亲手雕刻的螭龙纹镜架支住，案前插了九柱香，摆了瓜果。
陆江仙不禁有些汗颜，这案敬香供果，却像在祭拜他这个死人。
案前李尺泾三拜九叩，跪着躬身低头，恭恭敬敬地开口道：
“李家弟子李尺泾，恭请玄明妙法，司命安神，奉道修行。”
“这吸纳月华的速度，未免太慢。”
“我看那田芸就挺好。”
“当以时言功，不负效信，随箓焚化，身谢太阴。”
李木田等人大为振奋，死死地盯着案面。
李尺泾言罢，便欲开口念出法诀纲要，谁知气海穴中白丸轻轻跃动，他一瞬间竟失了声，咿咿呀呀一句话也说不出。
陆江仙在镜中正半睡半醒着消磨时间，他早就吸纳足了月华之力，镜中的时间又长又无聊，陆江仙就像大学时听着无聊的水课一般，迷迷糊糊地睡着，有时眼睛一闭就过去了一天。
不多时，李尺泾掐了个诀，引导这道已经蜕变为乳白色的气流落入眉心，跨过十二重楼，落回气海穴。
李项平点点头，宽慰道：“如此神奇之物，夺天地造化，数量本就不多。”
霎时间，李尺泾眼前一亮，如水般的月光缓缓向眉心处游去，与那缕灵气交汇。

大哥李长湖打了个哈欠，摆了摆手，对着几个兄弟道：
“都回去睡觉吧，候了一夜，也疲了。”
如此三回，李尺泾才睁开眼睛，望了望天空，已经过去了两个时辰。
李长湖笑着摸摸李尺泾的脑袋，看父亲恭恭敬敬地将桌上的法鉴请了回去，又开口道：
“待到夏至，我们几个一同请法。”
李尺泾的灵力从眉心跃出，落入镜上的月晕中，霎时惊醒了陆江仙，看着眼前的小男孩他不禁暗笑。
“哈哈哈哈哈哈…”李长湖大笑着进了前院。
“我得了玄珠符种，朦胧间脑中多了许多东西，什么修仙六境，什么胎息养轮，这法鉴好像只能分出六枚符种。”李尺泾坦言道。
陆江仙同时心念一动，镜面上顿时流光溢彩，如水波粼粼。
“有戏！”
“你这孩子！”李长湖却也大大方方，笑着指了指李项平，又低声道
“父亲哥哥！我得了玄珠符种，已经跨入修仙之门！”李尺泾兴奋地一跃而起，激动地抱住了父亲。
李尺泾闭目盘膝坐在院中，双手掐诀，从气海穴中引出一道气流，从经脉中游走，跃过喉颈处十二重楼，从眉心处浮现而出。
“是怕嫂子担心吧！”李项平哈哈一笑，揶揄道。
却见那青灰色鉴子嗡嗡作响，镜面上跃起一道白丸，圆坨坨光灼灼，白光闪烁，照的庭中白茫茫一片，亮得几人睁不开眼。
“只有六枚？”李通崖本提着《接引法》细细读着，闻言望向了他，疑惑地反问道。
————
李尺泾仔细一算，吸纳月华八十一回便可练成一缕月华之气，足足八十一缕便可形成胎息六轮第一轮——玄景轮。
“这仙法写不出也念不出，好生神奇。”李尺泾脸色微变，露出狼狈的神色。
李尺泾只觉得脑中一片空白，轰然作响，一道威严厚重的声音骤然浮现：

那白丸授了法诀，在泥丸宫轻轻一转，顺着经脉而走，最后落在了下丹田气海穴中。
待到太阴落下，金乌飞起，李尺泾终于浑身一震，缓缓醒来。他张目一望，身边围了一圈兄弟，满是焦虑不安的神色。
李木田捻着胡须，心中暗道。
李木田乐呵呵地抱着李尺泾转了一圈，李通崖几人长舒了一口气，神色也兴奋激动起来。
炼成了玄景轮，便算入了胎息，可以施展法术了。
“有反应了！”
李尺泾连忙从地上爬起，盘膝而坐，那道白丸一跃而起，没入其泥丸宫，他顿时全身一震，淹没在脑海中繁复的信息里。
“不必紧张。”
见自己又能开口说话，李尺泾长舒一口气，不信邪地又试图念出法诀纲要，却发现念不出也默不出。
“大哥乱点什么鸳鸯谱！”李项平脸庞一板，扭头出了院子，回房中去了。
他大惊失色，下意识地捂住嘴，又开口唤道：
“父亲！”
望着法鉴上蕴聚的月华，李尺泾眨了眨眸子，灵机一动，盘膝坐在石台边修炼起来。
是夜，月光如水。
“兹有李氏子弟，戒除情性，止塞愆非，制断恶根。赐下玄明妙法，使之发生道业，从凡入圣，自始及终，先从戒箓，然始登真。赐下《太阴吐纳养轮经》一卷，金光术一道。”
“大哥。”李尺泾却是打断了他，犹犹豫豫地说：“这符种好似只有六枚。”
李木田几人看着那玄珠符种没入李尺泾头顶，顿时紧张不已，提心吊胆地看着李尺泾盘膝而坐，闭目存神，就这样盘膝坐到了天亮。
“我得了一法诀，唤作《太阴吐纳养轮经》”
言罢，他放空心神，催动法诀，多次服食自然太和之气。
“三回两个时辰，八十一回便是五十四个时辰。”李尺泾在心中计较着：“一天修炼六个时辰，便要九天。八十一缕足足需要两年……”

“好生聪明。”
李尺泾却引导着灵气落回气海穴，只觉得浑身一凉，那月华之力足足壮大了十余倍，这么一看，只需五六次便可形成一缕月华之气了！
他不禁大为振奋，双手掐诀，继续修炼起来。直到朝霞遍天，几位哥哥都到了后院，这才依依不舍地结束修炼。
见到哥哥父亲都到了，李尺泾将昨夜的事情一说，几人都是且惊且喜，李木田叹着气又给陆江仙上了柱香，带着孩子们退出了暗室。
(本章完)

Chapter 9 White Pill
Willow shoots on the moon.
Li Chijing suddenly opened his eyes and looked at Li Mutian who was sitting next to him and drinking tea while holding a piece of cloth that recorded the "Jie Yin Method".
"Father, I have become familiar with the techniques in the past two months." He paused and said, "Today is the beginning of summer in the Eighth Festival, so I might give it a try."
"Go try it."
Li Mutian nodded and said slowly.
Li Chijing was overjoyed, and his three brothers were also full of expectations. They helped burn incense and bathe, and set up a desk in the courtyard.
Then Li Mutian respectfully asked for the Dharma Jian, supported it on the mirror frame with chilong patterns that he had carved by himself a few days ago, placed nine sticks of incense in front of the table, and placed melons and fruits.
Lu Jiangxian couldn't help but feel a little ashamed. Offering incense and fruits in this case was like worshiping a dead person.
Before the case, Li Chijing bowed three times and kowtowed nine times. He knelt down, bowed his head, and said respectfully:
"Li Chijing, a disciple of the Li family, respectfully requests Xuanming's magical method to calm the mind and practice Taoism."
"This speed of absorbing the moonlight is too slow."
"I think Tian Yun is pretty good."
"You should show your merits at the right time, and if you live up to your promise, you should be burned in a urn, and your body should be thanked by Taiyin."
Li Mutian and others were greatly excited and stared at the case.
After Li Chijing finished speaking, he was about to recite the outline of the method. Unexpectedly, the white pills in the Qihai acupoint danced lightly, and he lost his voice for a moment, babbling and unable to utter a word.
Lu Jiangxian was half asleep and half awake killing time in the mirror. He had already absorbed the power of the moonlight. The time in the mirror was long and boring. Lu Jiangxian was like listening to a boring water class in college. He fell asleep in a daze. Sometimes a day passed as soon as he closed his eyes.
Not long after, Li Chijing made a secret and guided the airflow that had transformed into milky white to fall into the center of his eyebrows, across the twelfth floor of the building, and back to the Qihai Cave.
Li Xiangping nodded and said with relief: "There are not many such magical things that can conquer the world."
In an instant, Li Chijing's eyes lit up, and the water-like moonlight slowly swam towards the center of his eyebrows, intersecting with that ray of spiritual energy.
The eldest brother Li Changhu yawned, waved his hands, and said to the brothers:
"Go back to bed. I'm tired after waiting all night."
After doing this three times, Li Chijing opened his eyes and looked at the sky. Two hours had passed.
Li Changhu smiled and touched Li Chijing's head. Seeing his father respectfully take back the Dharma Jian on the table, he said again:
"We will pray together until the summer solstice."
Li Chijing's spiritual power jumped out from between his eyebrows and fell into the moon halo on the mirror. Lu Jiangxian was instantly awakened. He couldn't help but smile to himself when he looked at the little boy in front of him.
"Hahahahahaha..." Li Changhu laughed and entered the front yard.
"I got the Xuanzhu talisman, and there were a lot of things in my hazy mind, such as the Sixth Realm of Immortal Cultivation, and the Breath Breathing Wheel. It seems that this Dharma Dictionary can only distinguish six talisman types." Li Chijing said frankly.
Lu Jiangxian thought at the same time, and the mirror suddenly filled with light, like sparkling water.
"There's a show!"
"You kid!" Li Changhu was also generous, pointed at Li Xiangping with a smile, and whispered
"Father, brother! I have obtained the Xuanzhu talisman and have entered the gate of immortality!" Li Chijing jumped up excitedly and hugged his father excitedly.
Li Chijing sat cross-legged in the courtyard with his eyes closed, making secrets with his hands, drawing a stream of air from the Qihai point, traveling through the meridians, leaping over the twelve layers of the throat and neck, and emerging from the center of the eyebrows.
"I'm afraid that my sister-in-law will be worried!" Li Xiangping laughed and teased.
But I saw the blue-gray mirror buzzing, and a white pill jumped up on the mirror. The round tuotuo light was burning, and the white light flickered, illuminating the courtyard with a vast whiteness, which was so bright that several people could not open their eyes.
"Only six?" Li Tongya read the "Jie Yin Fa" carefully. Hearing this, he looked at him and asked in confusion.
————
Li Chijing calculated carefully and found that by absorbing the moonlight eighty-one times, he would be able to cultivate a wisp of moonlight energy, and a full eighty-one wisps would be able to form the first round of the six rounds of fetal breath - the Xuanjing Wheel.
"I can't write or recite this immortal magic. It's so good to be alive."strange. "Li Chijing's face changed slightly, showing a look of embarrassment.
Li Chijing felt his mind go blank, and with a loud bang, a majestic and deep voice suddenly appeared:
The white pill was taught the magic formula, and it turned around slightly in the Niwan Palace, followed the meridians, and finally landed in the Qihai point of the lower Dantian.
When the sun set and the golden crow flew up, Li Chijing was finally shaken and slowly woke up. He opened his eyes and saw a circle of brothers surrounding him, all looking anxious.
Li Mutian twirled his beard and thought to himself.
Li Mutian happily hugged Li Chijing and spun him around. Li Tongya and others breathed a long sigh of relief and looked excited.
After you refine the Xuanjing Wheel, you have entered the fetal breath and can cast spells.
"There's a reaction! "
Li Chijing quickly got up from the ground and sat cross-legged. The white pill jumped up and submerged into his Niwan Palace. His whole body was shaken and he was drowned in the complicated information in his mind.
“Don’t be nervous. "
Seeing that he could speak again, Li Chijing breathed a long sigh of relief, and tried to recite the outline of the method without believing it, but found that he could not read it or speak silently.
"Brother, what kind of mandarin duck rules are you messing with! "Li Xiangping's face was stern, he turned around and walked out of the yard, returning to his room.
He was shocked, covered his mouth subconsciously, and called out again:
"Father! "
Looking at the moonlight accumulated on the Dharma Book, Li Chijing blinked his eyes, then had an idea, and sat cross-legged on the edge of the stone platform to practice.
It's night, the moonlight is like water.
“I, the disciples of the Li family, should abstain from their emotions, stop their wrongdoings, and control their evil roots. Give the mysterious and wonderful method to cause Taoism, from the ordinary to the holy, from the beginning to the end, first start with the precepts, and then reach the true level. I was given a volume of "Taiyin Breathing and Nurturing Wheel Sutra" and a golden light technique. "
"Brother. Li Chijing interrupted him and said hesitantly: "There seem to be only six of these talismans." "
Li Mutian and others watched the mysterious bead talisman sink into the top of Li Chijing's head, and they were immediately nervous. They watched with fear as Li Chijing sat cross-legged, closed his eyes and concentrated, and sat cross-legged like this until dawn.
"I have obtained a secret, called "Taiyin Breathing and Breathing Nourishing Wheel Sutra"
After saying this, he let go of his mind, activated the magic formula, and took the natural harmony energy many times.
"Three chapters are two hours, and eighty-one chapters are fifty-four hours. Li Chijing was calculating in his mind: "It takes nine days to practice for six hours a day." Eighty-one strands take two years..."
“So smart. "
However, Li Chijing guided the spiritual energy back to the Qihai Point, and felt a chill all over his body. The power of the moonlight had grown more than ten times. It only took five or six times to form a wisp of moonlight energy!
He couldn't help but feel very excited, made a secret with both hands, and continued to practice. It wasn't until the morning glow filled the sky and several brothers arrived in the backyard that they reluctantly ended their practice.
Seeing that his brother and father had arrived, Li Chijing told them what happened last night, and everyone was surprised and happy. Li Mutian sighed and gave Lu Jiangxian some incense, and took the children out of the darkroom.
(End of chapter)
